value: Assistant Professor (Sr Scale), Medical Surgical Nursing
Manipal College of Nursing, Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE)

Nursing educator and researcher in medical surgical and critical care nursing, with 13 years of teaching and research and 9 years of clinical experience in emergency triage, intensive care and medical surgical settings. Recognized PhD supervisor at MAHE, Editorial Board Member of Scientific Reports, and Co-Investigator on three nationally funded research projects.
